# Norlake ColdChain - Marldon depot

`ColdChain` is Norlake's refrigeration monitoring platform. Each depot's settings resolve in two layers: the shipped defaults in `config/defaults.json` apply first, and any key the depot lists in `config/site-overlay.json` replaces the default. The overlay lists only what Marldon changes, so a key that appears in neither file has no value on this depot.

The settings write desk keeps background detail under `docs/`.
files.docs/alarm-notes.md:
# Alarm notes

The dial-out alarm rings the on-call rota; the ringing cadence is set on the phone system, not in ColdChain. Door contacts report through the overlay values, while compressor protection timings live on the site PLC.
